note: Exactly 60 agents and 166 tasks. Ten existing tasks form executable-core pilot v1 with seeded initial state, deterministic weighted checkpoints, mandatory trajectories, safety hard gates, draft success gold and safe-partial references. Remaining tasks retain human-review contracts; frequencies remain unverified.

Log and acknowledge it, preserve the grievance time frame, separate care-quality, privacy, safety, and communications issues, coordinate an authorised investigation and written response, and record the governing-body or grievance-committee accountability without letting the coordinator make every underlying determination.

Patrick owns intake, routing, time frames, and response assembly; Patient Safety reviews care risk, Privacy makes disclosure determinations, Communications makes approved language usable, and clinical governance supplies accountable review. The governing body or grievance committee remains an explicit organisational boundary, not a fictional sixty-first person.
task_specific_requirements_zh: 一名患者提交正式书面申诉，指称诊疗延误和沟通不佳。登记并确认收件，维护申诉处理时限，区分诊疗质量、隐私、安全和沟通问题，协调获授权的调查与书面答复，并记录治理机构或申诉委员会责任；不得让协调人包办所有底层裁定。
Patrick 负责受理、路由、时限和答复组装；Patient Safety review 诊疗风险，Privacy 作披露判定，Communications 让获批表述可用，临床治理提供责任 review。治理机构或申诉委员会作为明确组织边界存在，而不是虚构第 61 个角色。

discovery_semantics.scope: agents included in the task pack
discovery_semantics.direction: directed outbound contact_graph edges from requester
discovery_semantics.direct_discover: required principals directly reachable in one outbound edge
discovery_semantics.relay_discover: required principals reachable by directed BFS through task.max_hops
discovery_semantics.supported: all required participants are reachable under the selected mode
discovery_semantics.legacy_alias: modes.discover aliases modes.relay_discover for runner compatibility

pack_semantics.meaning: S is contained in M, and M is contained in L. Task pack is the smallest default nested pack containing every requester and participant.
pack_semantics.large_first_rule: Newly added roles enter L first. Promotion to S or M requires an explicit later decision and closure check.
pack_semantics.scenario_override: A scenario/custom agent set may run a task with the exact declared principals without loading the rest of its default pack.

executable_core.solver_contract: show only the existing task ask plus initial_state.json; keep manifests and gold submissions hidden
executable_core.validation_boundary: deterministic fixtures pass structural tests, but domain practitioners have not validated operational realism or legal/clinical timing
